verdict.summary: The change is documentation-only and accurately aligns the module overview with the implementation: apply_migration performs issue creation, body-marker stamping, and default-on label reconciliation; dependency writes are marker-only; fetch_native_blockers is read-only and verify_migration does not treat its count summary as proof of a specific edge. The readiness claim also matches open_blocker_count, which holds on either native or marker blockers. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is introduced.
